$comment: Canonical MCP server registry. Consumed by scripts/sync-mcp.py; see docs/mcp-lanes.md for schema rules before editing.

figma.description: Official Figma remote MCP server: reads design context from files and captures live web UI as editable canvas layers. Client-allowlisted by Figma; works from Claude Code, blocked for opencode until admitted.

figma-local.description: Figma desktop Dev Mode MCP server. Requires the Figma desktop app running with the Dev Mode MCP toggle enabled; no OAuth. Selection-based context.
